findings.title: Upload PID is lost across the open-to-bind continuation
findings.evidence: ManagedH2Client.open returns {:ok,original_handle,upload}; upload is PID or nil and is independent of handle.stream. Current Session retains upload only in open_selected local scope and passes it to ready immediately after bind. Proposed bind state has no upload field, request_options=nil and payload-free continuation, so streamed upload cannot reach ready.

Session.select currently passes only member.config to select_transport; handoff stores handle/config only; open_selected receives config only. prepare_group_open(state, selected, now) cannot validate original id/max_inflight or actual three-key Selected from these values.

Root selected one member/config root in group-only awaiting_transport variant, not separate config plus duplicated selected.config. No global Session key. Preserve H2 config based on selected protocol/client before old state.client URI rewrite; invalid H2-group shape never falls through to legacy generic open. Freeze the exact pure helper return/error and result-decision tags and the third argument of group_open_result/3 before independent test/Session authoring.

findings.title: Original lifetime/opening anchors and timer application need explicit placement
findings.evidence: Current apply_limits reduces deadline using started_at+effective.max_lifetime and opening_deadline using activated_at+effective.opening_timeout, then resets both timers. Pure Boundary context has now/limits/deadline/opening_deadline but no original anchors; lowering effective limits alone cannot reproduce these absolute clamps. Recomputing from now would extend an already aged member budget; dropping the old generic open_selected call may omit apply_limits entirely on the direct path.
findings.required_change: Require original-anchor arithmetic in group Session path before building Boundary context: deadline=min(old,started_at+effective.max_lifetime), opening=min(oldOpening,deadline,activated_at+effective.opening_timeout), checked signed64 and cleanup headroom. Keep timer cancellation/rearming in actual callback outside pure state helper. open continuation recomputes remaining from those unchanged absolute deadlines, never refreshes from now. Add pure transition tests with aged anchors and smaller member limits.

findings.title: Pure transport-order rejection has no authority/reference input
findings.evidence: Pure prepare4 receives group H and one Selected, not the owner record/full ordered member set. Two unique permutations of H.transports can each be valid first-occurrence orders for different groups. It cannot determine which ordering was forged. Plan currently requires rejecting out-of-order transport list, conflating ordered shape with owner-record authority.
findings.required_change: Pure tests reject duplicates and invalid handles and preserve input order; no sorting or fabricated canonical order. Authenticate full ordered H by the future existing owner record equality, explicitly outside pure proof. Remove isolated out-of-order rejection unless comparing a second existing state alias with an already specified exact H, which proves only alias consistency.

observations.text: A pure prepare4 plus literal denial and actual guarded Session state transitions is a smaller useful dependency than detached all-phase transfer APIs. Four implementation/test paths are sufficient; no new process/dependency/HTTP admission/Options/owner/Probe/reservation/fixed projector work is necessary.

Selected protocol/client, exact selected T membership and normalized checked origin matching must precede preservation of raw selected URI. Current old state.client decides checkout URI rewriting, so a dedicated H2-group branch is needed. Marker/shape never proves owner or instance association.

Upload may be reduced to min(endpoint/member max_chunk); source must first validate original compact Neutral. Existing prepare_group_request then preserves effective fields/pseudoheader checks. Ready must carry effective five limits so actual pump read_upload uses member-reduced chunk/write timeout; body_mode/content-length/header limits remain unchanged.

Drop before fail/settle must remove opening/selected/Neutral/K and submitted URL but retain original request/completion, transport/group tokens/pins, service token and managed_path. Existing bind transport-first and finish transport/pins→group→Service can be reused. Existing cleanup-unconfirmed stop/hold path and finite health neutrality remain separate from gate denial.

Literal activation denial is valid non-live scope control, not evidence of bounded live admission. Exact group-specific dispatch and unconditional gate dominance of every new open path require independent code review. No forged ready/accounting flag, helper result, public message or test adapter may invoke actual continuation. Queued cancel/DOWN pre-open handling remains a mandatory pre-activation obligation.

Startup four-root and separate Probe/recovery shape/source/overlap proofs remain future consumer-wired obligations. No numeric9Q/8C/4K/2MiB/11542108 reserve is adopted; fixed9444956 remains unchanged.

While threading H2 member, require same exact H in GroupEndpoint/selector/selection aliases before dropping them, and same exact selected T in selection/awaiting/transport_selection. Check selected raw origin length<=H.max_url_bytes as well as8192 to preserve advertised selected-origin bound; these checks establish coherence only, not owner authority.
